title: Can I BEAT Blindfold Chess?
summary: Online blindfold games vs ~1500 humans. The viewer sees the real board, but the player plays on a second, empty board that shows only last-move highlights and click circles, no pieces.
rules: Player's board shows no pieces: only last-move from/to highlights and legal-move/click indicators.
Moves are made by clicking squares on the empty board.
